title: Virtual Compute: assisted review — review total
content:
## Calculation basis

Virtual Compute assisted review — Floor the signed measured quantity at zero, multiply by the selected rate, region factor and configuration multiplier, apply the ordinary discount once, and then apply the support portfolio discount fraction to that discounted subtotal; round only this final reviewed net amount half-up to two USD decimals. This support adjustment is successive to ordinary pricing, including approved negotiated pricing.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for assisted review — review total?**

Floor the signed measured quantity at zero, multiply by the selected rate, region factor and configuration multiplier, apply the ordinary discount once, and then apply the support portfolio discount fraction to that discounted subtotal; round only this final reviewed net amount half-up to two USD decimals. This support adjustment is successive to ordinary pricing, including approved negotiated pricing.

## Hypothetical case

Hypothetical inputs are 25 net instance-hours, a selected price of 4 USD, a regional multiplier of 1, a configuration multiplier of 1, an ordinary reduction of 10% and a support reduction of 20%. The initial 100 USD becomes 90 USD after ordinary pricing, then 72.00 USD after support pricing. Adding the percentages and reducing the initial amount would instead give 70 USD and is not the prescribed successive operation.
